telemetry.rationale: One-second real host counter cadence, five-minute warmup plus five-second margin; retain existing 95% coverage and two-second gap/freshness gates. Exact bounds/available frontier and actual submission freshness are independently checked. No normalized demand assumed.

configuration_rationale: First nonempty complete training bin selected without outcomes, 113 real Snowset arrivals at their original spacing. Explicit balanced ordinal four-template mapping; not original SQL. One client retains prior isolation and exposes capacity honestly, with all residual queue identities at the fixed 60-second horizon; no thinning, compression, dispatch after horizon or cancellation. No maintenance. Complete telemetry warmup and existing gates; exact source snapshot/files remain read-only. Operational 14:00 IST cutoff is a safeguard, not a scientific observation horizon. A separate mapping-source audit passed before this registration. No cost-training/scheduler acceptance.
limitations: One warehouse/minute and artificial declared query mix, not original Snowflake workload reproduction.
One serial query client with diagnostic layout; capacity does not generalize to production or prove optimal concurrency.
Boundary observation lateness and actual generator lag reported, not assumed zero.
No counterfactual action effect, accepted cost labels, SLA, model fit or scheduler benefit.
